Chunk 0 is the H1-only title slide (exempt by convention). Chunks 1-6 each carry 2-4 bullets landing a self-carrying claim: chunk1 skill definition + why it outlives the thread; chunk2 the borrowed/own split; chunk3 personal-first path + team-kit growth; chunk4 the proportion + the bolded principle; chunk5 the three trust artifacts + the next-engineer test; chunk6 the three tool-flags-you-decide judgment calls + the 'Go.' kicker. None is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent fragment.

Checked all 6 headers against current content. Ch1 'A skill outlives the thread it came from' -> bullet 2 delivers exactly this (Slack thread dies in 48h vs. a skill lives as long as the repo). Ch2 'Borrowed judgement, or your own' -> the two bullets are literally the security-practitioner (borrowed) and you-right-now (own) cases. Ch3 'Your authored skill starts personal, then compounds' -> personal path bullet, then Fin/Intercom team-kit-growth bullet. Ch4 'Two curated, one authored' -> the proportion, both counterfactuals, and the principle. Ch5 'Three trust artifacts the next engineer checks' -> names the three artifacts and closes on the next-engineer test. Ch6 'The tool flags; you make the call' -> access-control/STRIDE/test-pyramid, each ending on a you-decide beat. No header is contradicted by its own chunk.

Command run this session: `grep -nE "Not [A-Z][a-z]+\. Not " curriculum/lectures/skills-from-the-frontier.md` -> no matches anywhere in the file (banned construction absent). Manual per-sub-item scan of lines 1-39: no anaphora/epistrophe triple (closest is chunk3 line17's doublet 'skill by skill, engineer by engineer' — two legs, not three, so the third-leg-must-earn-it test doesn't apply); no self-grading superlative (`grep -niE "most useful|one of the most|best in class|the ultimate"` on lines 1-39 -> no matches); no number-with-retraction (chunk3 line17's '153 contributors, 31% of R&D headcount active, by the company's own count' is a number with its attribution label, not a hedge-then-retract — matches the documented vendor-self-report hedge pattern per the maintainer's pre-cohort note at line 121, not the retraction shape this sub-item bans); no abstraction-noun stack; no verb triplet with an empty leg (chunk6 line34's 'got right / underweighted / missed' are three distinct, concrete judgment axes, not filler).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture headings should be claims (subject+verb assertions). Ch1 'A skill outlives the thread it came from' (verb: outlives — a genuine claim, and the 2026-09-0x rename from the label 'What a skill is' fixed exactly this for chunk 1). Ch3 'Your authored skill starts personal, then compounds' (verbs: starts, compounds), Ch5 '...the next engineer checks' (verb: checks), Ch6 'The tool flags; you make the call' (verbs: flags, make) are all genuine claims. Ch2 'Borrowed judgement, or your own' and Ch4 'Two curated, one authored' remain bare noun-phrase/ratio labels with no verb. Neither matches a NOT-violation example verbatim, though both read close to 'catalogue entries naming their subject' (cf. 'The numbers', 'Verification, named'), and the rule's own text documents being walked back on 2026-08-19 after over-firing non-blocking on ten lectures ('a rule that only ever produces notes is a rule mis-scoped'). Harm check: neither header leaves a reader unable to follow the slide — the failure mode is register/mood flatness, not comprehension, which is this rule's own stated test for non-blocking. Filed as a TODO for the maintainer's own read, not a mechanical failure.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: If tightened: 'Someone else's judgement, or yours' (ch2) / 'Two proportions, and only one of them you can author' (ch4) restate the same content as verb-bearing claims — or leave as-is under the catalogue-entry reading, which this rule's own history treats as acceptable for enumerating/labeling slides.
